Sheaffer Ballpoint Pen 321 Sentinel Black with Chrome Trim

The Sheaffer Ballpoint Pen 321 Sentinel Black with Chrome Trim is a refined writing instrument designed for professionals who value precision, style, and durability. Crafted with legacy of excellence, this premium ball pen combines modern aesthetics with trusted performance, making it an ideal choice for daily office use as well as formal gifting.

Featuring a sleek slim profile and a smooth push-button mechanism, this ball pen offers effortless writing with a balanced grip that ensures comfort during extended writing sessions. The elegant contrast between the glossy black barrel and polished chrome accents adds a sophisticated touch that complements any professional environment.

Premium Design & Superior Craftsmanship

Designed with a high-quality resin barrel and a durable chrome cap featuring chrome plate trim, the Ballpoint Pen 321 Sentinel reflects timeless elegance. The streamlined silhouette enhances portability while maintaining a premium feel, making it a dependable writing companion for executives, students, and creatives alike.

The precision-engineered mechanism ensures consistent ink flow, delivering clean and uninterrupted lines every time. Whether signing documents, taking notes, or gifting a colleague, this premium ballpoint pen stands out as a symbol of reliability and refined taste.

Effortless Writing Performance

Equipped with this pen delivers smooth, skip-free writing and long-lasting performance. The refill is easily replaceable, ensuring your Sheaffer ball pen remains functional for years. The push-button action is responsive and reliable, making it suitable for fast-paced professional settings.

  • Original Sheaffer ‘K’ Ballpoint refill included
  • Consistent ink flow for smooth writing
  • Easy refill replacement
  • Ideal for everyday office and executive use
